name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaSocial MVP slice for authorized public social-data trends sentiment or topic monitoring with measurable acceptance criteria. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when implementing an approved integration or planning private-data collection.

# Product scope

- Start from `README.md` planned capabilities ethics rules and Beta criteria.
- Choose one official or authorized API and one public-data use case.
- Define query scope retention output and classifier quality criteria.
- State platform terms privacy and rate-limit constraints.
- Exclude private data access control bypass and unauthorized scraping.
- Require tests documented source behavior and limitations before completion.
